subject: Co-sponsored Proof-of-Value stipend routing for integrator-led PoV
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgewave.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: co-sponsor stipend for Arbor Health PoV

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the intro to Redwood — really excited about the potential fit. We have a committed PoV with Arbor Health (clinical search + summarization workflow) that kicks off the week of Nov 27. The customer is already engaged on our side but needs a modest promotional stipend from Redwood to cover inference costs during the 4-week PoV so we can keep the trial friction low and hit the technical milestones.

High-level ask: a co-sponsored PoV stipend equal to approx. $5,000 in hosted tokens (or a voucher that maps to estimated 200k generation tokens / equivalent compute). The usage estimate is attached (usage_estimate_edgewave.xlsx) — peak test days only, mostly short chat+summary endpoints.

What we need from Redwood to move forward:
- Confirmation of promotional stipend/voucher and any gating requirements (marketplace listing / co-marketing opt-in)
- Simple addendum to the MSA to cover credit consumption and expiration (we can route via DocuSign)
- Target delivery date for voucher code or grant allocation (aiming for Nov 22 to allow onboarding)

I’ve cc’d Kimberly on the thread for ops/eligibility. Jared Lin (Arbor Health) is looped in on the customer side — Jared, feel free to reply with any questions about the scope.

Attachments: Arbor_POv_SOW_draft.pdf, usage_estimate_edgewave.xlsx

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Partnerships, EdgeWave Integrations
maya.patel@edgewave.io | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgewave.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-11-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: co-sponsor stipend for Arbor Health PoV

Maya — thanks for the detailed ask and the attachments. This looks straightforward and aligns with our partner stipend playbook. Quick answers and next steps:

1) Eligibility: provisional yes, pending Marketplace entitlements + a short co-marketing blurb.
2) Amount: we can provision a $5k-equivalent voucher (or token allotment) but need signoff from Sales Ops (Kim) and final PoV timeline.
3) Legal: a short addendum is fine; DocuSign link for execution will be required before funds are released.
4) Delivery: if approved today, we can generate the voucher by Nov 21 — callout that when consumed on Redwood Hosted it will follow our standard TTL (90 days) unless otherwise specified.

Action items:
- Kim: can you confirm ops criteria (marketplace ent checked + co-marketing clause ok) and whether we should route via marketplace voucher or direct account credit?
- Soojin: please flag any compliance/security red flags for Arbor Health’s PoV (PHI handling note — we need to confirm whether data will be de-identified).
- Maya/Jared: please confirm final PoV dates and whether Arbor needs invoices or just voucher codes.

I’ll await internal confirmations; happy to do a 15-min sync if that helps.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-11-08T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: co-sponsor stipend for Arbor Health PoV

On Wed, Nov 7, 2028 at 11:02 AM, priyom_das@redwood.example.com wrote:
> Maya — thanks for the detailed ask and the attachments. This looks straightforward and aligns with our partner stipend playbook. Quick answers and next steps:

Priyom / team — confirmed. Sales Ops will provision a provisional $5,000 voucher under a partner-funded voucher pool with the following gating:

- Marketplace entitlement is required (EdgeWave to confirm listing is live or in-process).
- Co-marketing opt-in: 1 short customer quote + partner logo placement on the PoV brief (if customer permits).
- Voucher TTL: 90 days from issuance; non-transferable.
- Accounting: we will create a line-item credit against RDW-PS_PROMO for Q4 reporting.

I’ve attached the voucher-template-redwood.docx (internal) to speed execution. Once Maya confirms marketplace status and Jared confirms customer ok for co-marketing, I’ll route the voucher for issuance. If legal needs the addendum, route to legal@redwood.example.com — however we can often do a signature-free addendum for promotional amounts under $10k if the customer agrees.

Kimberly Park
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: voucher-template-redwood.docx
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgewave.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, Jared Lin <jared.lin@arborhealth.org>
Date: 2028-11-09T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: co-sponsor stipend for Arbor Health PoV

Thanks Priyom/Kim — great, appreciate the quick turn. Quick answers:

- Marketplace: EdgeWave listing is live (partner page published last week) — attaching confirmation from our listings team.
- Co-marketing: Arbor Health is OK with a short quote and partner attribution for the PoV summary.
- PoV dates: Nov 27 -> Dec 22 (4-week window) — kickoff call set for Nov 28.
- Invoicing: Arbor prefers voucher codes rather than invoices for the trial; DocuSign addendum not required if promo is <$10k, Jared confirmed on the call.

Could we get the voucher issued by Nov 21 as requested? If you need a completed co-marketing blurb, I can drop it into the thread by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate the help — we’ll hit the kickoff and keep you posted on results.

Best,
Maya
Partnerships, EdgeWave Integrations
Attachments: edgewave_listing_confirmation.pdf
